scenario: Multi-justifier coalescence gives the same fact set whichever justifier activated first (LDET.8.3.1). `from_a` and `from_b` both emit `Shared logical v: 1`. TrigA is asserted and pumped, so `from_a` justifies Shared first, then TrigB is asserted and pumped. TrigA, the first justifier, is retracted and pumped. Shared must still be live on `from_b`'s support: a Probe makes `read_back` log it exactly once. Its sibling, logical/LDET.8.3.1_coalesced_lifetime_b_first, runs the other order and expects the same message.
rules_ds:
schema TrigA scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema TrigB scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Shared scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Probe scope logical:
    n: Int key

rule from_a:
    TrigA
->
    emit Shared logical v: 1

rule from_b:
    TrigB
->
    emit Shared logical v: 1

rule read_back:
    Probe
    Shared s
->
    log info "shared {s.v}"
